    core 0.1.1 API

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb
    CockroachDB pure-Java library — a framework-free, annotation-driven toolkit that makes CockroachDB anomaly handling (serialization-conflict retries, circuit breaking) disappear behind runtime dynamic proxies.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.annotations
    Runtime annotations that drive CockroachDB-aware behavior through the dynamic-proxy engine.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.anomaly
    Typed, exhaustive modelling of CockroachDB failure modes.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.circuit
    A thread-safe circuit breaker that fast-fails calls after repeated failures.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.config
    Library-wide configuration records.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.context
    Virtual-thread-safe call context (region, vCluster, workload, follower-read staleness) carried via Java's ScopedValue — not ThreadLocal — so it propagates correctly across structured concurrency and virtual threads.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.observe
    Lightweight observability hooks.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.proxy
    The dynamic-proxy engine: the headline feature that makes CockroachDB anomaly try/catch disappear.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.retry
    Adaptive, contention-aware retry for CockroachDB serialization anomalies.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.spi
    Service-provider interfaces and value types for the Cockroach Continuum surfaces exposed through Crdb.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.tx
    Programmatic transaction execution with adaptive retry and follower-read support — the always-available functional core of the library.
    com.cockroachlabs.crdb.vcluster
    The Cockroach vCluster entry point returned by Crdb.vcluster(String).
